description: This file defines a class for loading, configuring, and using a DenseNet-121 model for image classification, including methods for loading classes, images, and model weights, as well as classifying images and printing predictions.

classes.name: DenseNet121Pretrained
classes.description: A class for loading a DenseNet-121 model, loading class labels, images, and model weights, and performing image classification with top-k predictions.

methods.name: __init__
methods.description: Initializes the DenseNet121Pretrained object, loads the model architecture, and class labels.

methods.name: __load_classes
methods.description: Loads class labels from a file.

methods.name: __load_image
methods.description: Loads images from a file or directory, preprocesses them for model input.

methods.name: model_path
methods.description: Property to get or set the model weights file path.

methods.name: set_model_path
methods.description: Sets the path to the pretrained weights file.

methods.name: load_model
methods.description: Loads the pretrained weights into the model.

methods.name: classify
methods.description: Classifies images at a given path, returning top-k predictions and optionally printing them.
